subject: AllegroTech vendor onboarding — PO reissue & spend cap
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@allegrotech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@allegrotech.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO issuance question

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier this week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood but have a small snag on the PO side before we can finalize the first month. Procurement asked me to confirm the exact PO number format Redwood needs and whether a provisional PO is acceptable while internal approvals complete. Also: our initial spend cap needs to be $35,000 for July (we may increase in August).

Attached is our completed vendor onboarding form (allegrotech_vendor_form.pdf). The purchase request we submitted to our finance team references three line items (Core API usage, Dedicated support, and Onboarding professional services) but the PO generator in our system split services across two GL codes and created duplicate lines — we've asked them to consolidate but wanted to make sure Redwood's billing will match the final PO.

Can you confirm:
- Do you accept provisional PO numbers (temporary) or do you need a finalized number to start provisioning?
- Any specific PO field Redwood requires to map the spend cap and line items?

If you want, loop in procurement@allegrotech.com and I can push the correction request through our system.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, AllegroTech
Attachment: allegrotech_vendor_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@allegrotech.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO issuance question

Hi Samir — glad to hear you're ready to go. Quick answers and next steps below.

Short answers: provisionals OK to start provisioning; we prefer the finalized PO before the first invoice but can accept a provisional PO to reserve capacity. For mapping we need: PO number, spend cap total, and the primary line that maps to "API consumption" so our billing system can allocate tokens to the correct ledger.

What I actioned for you:
- Attached a short onboarding checklist (Redwood_onboard_checklist.pdf) — please confirm the PO number and the line-item that should be treated as "consumption".
- I CC'd Priyom to request a provisional PO in Redwood's procurement system and Monica to route billing so she can set the spend cap once PO is issued.

Can you resend the corrected line items (or attach the finalized PO) when available? If procurement wants to issue a temporary PO number, we'll accept it but will mark it as provisional in our ledger until final is shared.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_onboard_checklist.pdf (pdf)

Jordan / Monica — I created a provisional PO record in our internal system this morning so we can start provisioning AllegroTech. Details:
- Temp PO: PROV-ALGT-00972 (marked provisional)
- Assigned spend cap: $35,000 (July)
- Lines created: 4 (API consumption, Support retainer, Onboarding PS, Integration hours) — note: procurement created a duplicate "Onboarding PS" line, so we have an extra line ID 004 that will need to be collapsed to match AllegroTech's corrected submission.

Connor, can you please:
1) Reassign the duplicate line 004 to merge into the Onboarding PS line (ID 003) and ensure the GL code maps to 520-PS rather than 521-INT.
2) If possible, convert PROV-ALGT-00972 to a proper PO number once AllegroTech confirms the corrected line items (they've promised an updated file).

Jordan — I'll hold on converting to a formal PO until Samir confirms final lines. Once converted, we can email the formal PO (PDF) and Monica will set billing allocations.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference

We've consolidated the duplicate onboarding line and kept the three logical buckets your billing team asked for. Please reissue the final PO number when you're ready; our finance team will allow the provisional number for one billing cycle but requests the final PO before month-end.

- Line A: API consumption — GL 430 (quantity = monthly usage estimate 1)
- Line B: Support retainer — GL 622 (flat rate)
- Line C: Onboarding professional services — GL 520 (one-time; quantity = 40 hours)

Samir — thanks for the clean spreadsheet, that helps a lot. Quick run-down and confirmation: 

1) Connor merged the duplicate line and updated the GL code to 520-PS as requested.
2) We've issued the formal PO: PO-ALGT-000972 (attached PDF). This replaces the provisional PROV-ALGT-00972 and will be used for all invoices starting July 15 onward.
3) Monica has set the spend cap in our billing system to $35,000 for July and placed an alert at 85% consumption so both teams get notified.

Next steps for actions:
- Samir: confirm the final PO in your finance system so your ledger picks up PO-ALGT-000972 (our accounting reference attached).
- Priyom: please close the provisional PO ticket and archive PROV-ALGT-00972.
- Monica / Connor: please monitor initial billing run July 14–16 and escalate any mismatches to Samir directly.

Attaching the formal PO PDF: PO-ALGT-000972.pdf (pdf)

If anything doesn't map or your AP team needs a different field populated, flag it here and we'll get it fixed before the first invoice.

Cheers,
